jobs.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description BETSOLs team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. Key responsibilities Testing SAM publisher implementations Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. Building and running test automation Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. Quality process and reporting Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. Qualifications Required qualifications Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. Preferred qualifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus. Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based). Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports. jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer with deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning (RL) to join our team as a Senior Staff Architect. This includes building scalable training architectures, architecting multi-agent and hierarchical RL frameworks, and ensuring that the RL systems are resilient, efficient, explainable and safe. As a senior technical leader, you will partner with cross-functional teams including product, core platform engineering, and research to define architectural best practices, establish governance standards, and enable seamless integration of RL into our broader AGI platform. You will also drive innovation by exploring novel RL techniques, mentoring engineers and researchers, and ensuring the RL infrastructure can scale to support high-throughput training and real-world scenarios and enterprise use cases end to end. Ultimately, your work will be critical in bridging research and production, ensuring that the latest RL advancements translate into reliable, impactful, and enterprise-ready AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Design: Define and drive the end-to-end architecture for reinforcement learning-based systems, including training pipelines, simulation environments, reward shaping, and model serving. Research & Development: Apply cutting-edge RL techniques (policy optimization, model-based RL, hierarchical RL, multi-agent RL, etc) to solve complex enterprise problems. Scalability & Infrastructure: Design distributed training systems, leverage cloud-native infrastructure, and optimize for performance, reproducibility, and cost-efficiency. Leadership & Mentorship: Provide technical leadership to AI engineers and researchers; mentor junior team members; review designs and code with a focus on scalability, robustness, and clarity. Collaboration: Partner with product, data, and platform teams to align RL solutions with strategic business goals and integrate them into production systems. Evaluation & Monitoring: Define frameworks for benchmarking, continuous evaluation, and feedback-driven improvements in deployed RL models. Compliance & Safety: Ensure RL systems align with ethical AI practices, safety constraints, and regulatory standards for enterprises. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, including at least 5 years specializing in reinforcement learning research and production systems . Demonstrated success in designing and deploying large-scale RL architectures in enterprise environments. Deep expertise in reinforcement learning algorithms , including on-policy (PPO, A3C) and off-policy (SAC, DDPG) methods, along with hands-on work in simulation frameworks (e.g., OpenAI Gym, Isaac Gym, PettingZoo, MuJoCo). Practical experience with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) , including coordination strategies for complex environments. Strong proficiency in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and GRPO-like policy optimization approaches , applying reinforcement learning principles both rigorously and pragmatically. Advanced software engineering skills in Python, C++, or Java , with deep expertise in ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, or Ray RLlib . Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills , with experience working across multidisciplinary teams. Skills and attributes for success Primary : Proven hands-on experience as a Senior Full Stack Developer, with strong proficiency in C#/.NET Core, Angular or React and SQL Server. Strong hands-on experience developing, integrating, and maintaining microservices-based applications using .NET technologies. Hands-on experience developing and deploying applications using Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps, and Azure AI services. Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and working with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Solid knowledge of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, testing, debugging, and code-quality standards. Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, collaboration, and technical mentoring skills. Bachelor s or Master s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. Overall, 4-8 years of experience. Secondary: Demonstrated experience in the Risk domain, with a strong understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance, regulatory requirements, and technology-enabled risk solutions. Understanding of security, auditability, governance, and regulatory compliance requirements. Experience with high-availability and mission-critical enterprise applications. Experience with Python-based backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. Working knowledge about various AI Agents/ Agentic workflow and multi-agent frameworks and SDKs. Understanding of various types of Large Language Models (LLMs). Fundamental understanding of Retrieval Augment Generation (RAG) techniques. Experience with M365 Copilot Studio. Microsoft Azure AI-901/ AI-103 Certification. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Automation
jobs.description: Senior QA Engineer Automation Experience: 4+ Years Job Location: WFH / Hybrid No. of Positions: Multiple Qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field Work Timings: 1:30 PM IST to 10:30 PM IST About the Role We are looking for a skilled and versatile Senior QA Engineer with hands-on expertise in Web UI Automation, API Testing, and Application Security/Penetration Testing. In this dual-focus role, you will be responsible for ensuring both the functional excellence and security resilience of modern web applications and microservices. You will build and scale automated test suites while systematically identifying application-level security flaws, running vulnerability scans, and performing manual and automated penetration testing across web and API layers. Key Responsibilities Test Automation & API Testing Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites for web applications using modern UI frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium). Architect automated end-to-end API test suites for REST and GraphQL services (payload validation, contract testing, response times, auth token flows). Perform functional, regression, integration, cross-browser, and database verification testing. Embed UI and API automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) for continuous feedback and zero-defect releases. Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity and system states. Security & Penetration Testing Conduct vulnerability assessments and web application penetration testing aligned with OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10. Execute both dynamic application security testing (DAST) and manual penetration testing to uncover vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, XSS, Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR), CSRF, and SSRF. Perform API security audits focusing on authentication, authorization mechanisms (OAuth 2.0, JWT, API Keys), rate limiting, and parameter tampering. Integrate automated security scanning tools (e.g., OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk) into the DevSecOps/CI-CD workflow. Document security findings, assign severity scores (CVSS), and partner directly with development teams to triage, reproduce, and verify remediation. Collaboration & Quality Ownership Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Standups, Grooming) to ensure early threat modeling and quality planning. Analyze system logs and telemetry using tools like Splunk, Datadog, or ELK to conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on functional defects and security alerts. Maintain clear technical documentation, test strategies, and security vulnerability reports. Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Required Technical Skills 4+ years of core QA experience covering functional, regression, API, and automation testing. 1–2+ years of practical experience in Security Testing and Web/API Penetration Testing. Strong hands-on proficiency in building automation frameworks with tools like Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Karate. Solid experience in API testing (functional and security) using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, Insomnia, or Karate. Proven proficiency with web security assessment tools such as Burp Suite Professional/Community, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, or SQLmap. In-depth understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10 vulnerabilities and remediation strategies. Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) for data validation and backend verification. Solid experience with version control (Git) workflows (branching, pull requests, conflict resolution). Working knowledge of CI/CD integration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for running automated tests and automated security scans. 4-9 Yrs Software testing, Senior, Quality assurance, UI Automation, UI, ETL, Senior QA, Penetration

Key Skills (Must Have): Strong experience in Software Testing (Manual + Automation) White Box Testing (unit testing, code-level validation) Black Box Testing (functional, system, regression testing) Experience in testing AI Chatbots (Text Voice Video) Knowledge of Prompt Testing AI Response Validation Exposure to RAG pipelines and vector databases Performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner) Experience with CI/CD pipelines Understanding of data validation and model evaluation metrics Testing of AI/ML GenAI applications API Testing (Postman REST Assured) Test Automation (Selenium PyTest Playwright) Python Java (for test scripting) Understanding of LLMs, Chatbots, and AI workflows Test Case Design & Test Planning Defect Tracking Tools (JIRA, Bugzilla) Core Responsibilities: Perform White Box Testing : validate internal logic, code coverage, and workflows Perform Black Box Testing : validate functionality, UI/UX, and system behavior Test AI applications including chatbots, voice bots, and automation systems Validate LLM outputs, prompt responses, and edge cases Conduct API testing, integration testing, and regression testing Design and execute test cases, test plans, and automation scripts Identify, log, and track defects through resolution Work closely with developers, AI engineers, and product teams Ensure performance, scalability, and reliability of applications. 10-19 Yrs Box, SR, Artificial Intelligence, Part, Software QA, UNIT, Python, Software testing
